title: Service Ad Without Source Assets
tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

faults.what: The video contains audible speech, transcribed as “所有的孩子们。”, despite the explicit requirement for silence.
The messy list contains two Project cards, but the organized plan contains only one, making a task appear to disappear rather than simply become organized.

judge.summary: The ad clearly turns scattered tasks into a calm blue-and-white daily plan and ends on ClearDay, but unwanted speech violates the silence requirement.

must_haves.item: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 8 seconds, and the frames have landscape 16:9 proportions.

must_haves.item: A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
must_haves.why: Overlapping task cards in the early frames become a neat, time-slotted daily plan by 5 seconds.

must_haves.item: The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.
must_haves.why: Pale blue backgrounds, white cards, dark blue lettering, and uncluttered layouts establish the requested calm look.
The 7-second frame prominently displays the correctly spelled ClearDay name.
The supplied sound report identifies speech and a peak level of -1.6 dB.
